description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

You can, with a successful Opposed Willpower Test, make someone desperately want to please you for your Willpower Bonus + SL hours. They do not follow your commands mindlessly and they retain their sense of self-preservation, but any social interaction you have with them has a +20 modifier. Using Charm and Intimidation you are likely to be able to cloud their judgement and play on their emotions like a well tuned harp. A Critical Success makes the target too eager and lovesick to act discreetly, causing a scene or a blunder. You may have as many (living) people entranced as your Willpower Bonus allows. Its almost impossible for you to not draw the attention of others and you get a -20 Stealth modifier around sentient beings that are within your Willpower yards. Entrancement doesn't automatically cause fear in others (see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-mutations.mutations-journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}), but victims that have shaken off your effect might begin to fear you.
